profile_text.body:
Aurora Innovation, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, trading under the ticker AUR and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001828108. Its website presents it as a self-driving freight company, describing its core product as the Aurora Driver, a system built from hardware and software that the company says is backed by verifiable AI and can be integrated into a customer's fleet. The site's framing is that self-driving technology should be delivered safely, quickly, and broadly.

The site carries testimonials from partners rather than named executives. One describes a pilot program in which the Aurora Driver autonomously hauled freight between Fort Worth and El Paso, using a hybrid model combining Werner professional drivers with the Aurora Driver. Another states that the company has partnered with Aurora and that the Aurora Driver is integrated into the Volvo VNL Autonomous. The site also cites a projection that freight volumes will grow five fold between 2010 and 2050, and argues that autonomous transport follows from that demand.

The held record lists no lawsuits for the company, and its litigation exposure is recorded as 170 cases in Pennsylvania. No products or MCP servers are tracked in the record.
